blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian said on Thursday that Sen. Mark Villar’s vote to make the voting base to convict Vice President Sara Duterte more flexible does not indicate he is joining the Senate majority. The senator clarified that after Villar, the sole minority bloc member to do so, voted to let the impeachment court adjust the conviction threshold depending on how many senator-judges are present. “As of yesterday, yung kaniyang boto ay to overturn the ruling ng presiding officer. So yun lang yung kaniyang boto. Wala naman siyang binoto na majority or minority, SP wala namang ganon,” Gatchalian […]...
